sample_bbox_positive_negative: sample positive and negative bounding boxes from candidates using assign results and ground truth bboxes
sample_pos_abstract: implement a subclass that overrides _sample_pos to define custom positive sample selection logic
sample_neg_abstract: implement a subclass that overrides _sample_neg to define custom negative sample selection logic
init_basesampler: create a BaseSampler subclass with configurable num samples, pos fraction, and neg pos upper bound
review_basesampler_sampling_result: review the BaseSampler class and its sample method that returns a SamplingResult object
